annotation.intro: Anyone who can access this dataset can annotate it.
annotation.newHint: Create an annotation task. Everyone with access to the dataset will be able to take part.
annotation.name: Name
annotation.labelsHint: At least 2 labels, each with a different name.
annotation.selectWords: Select text with the mouse (or click a word, shift + click to extend), then pick one or more labels. Passages may overlap.
annotation.pickLabel: Choose an entity type (or press its number).

classification.title: Classification
classification.hint: Give one label to each text.

ner.title: Entity extraction
ner.hint: Highlight the people, places, etc. in the text.

qa.title: Question answering
qa.hint: Write several question-answer pairs per text and highlight their source.

row_label.title: Row labelling
row_label.hint: Give a label to each row (normal, suspect, duplicate…).

cell_review.title: Cell review
cell_review.hint: Flag a wrong or missing value and give the right one.

column_schema.title: Column schema
column_schema.hint: Describe each column: role, type, format and unit.

regression.title: Regression
regression.hint: Give a number to each text or row: a score, a rating, a price…

image_detection.title: Object detection
image_detection.hint: Draw a polygon around each object and give it a label.

image_segmentation.title: Segmentation
image_segmentation.hint: Outline the regions of the image (road, sky…) with polygons.

image_classification.title: Image classification
image_classification.hint: Give a label to each image.

image_caption.title: Image to text
image_caption.hint: Describe each image with one or more sentences.

image_polyline.title: Lines

image_keypoints.title: Keypoints
image_keypoints.hint: Place named points on each object: joints, corners, landmarks.

image_vqa.title: Visual question answering
image_vqa.hint: Write questions about the image and their answers.

audio_caption.title: Audio to text

video_segments.title: Labelled segments

video_caption.title: Video to text
video_caption.hint: Describe each video, or each of its parts.

timeseries_segments.title: Labelled segments

timeseries_caption.title: Series to text

image.hintSelect: Drag a point to move it. Delete removes the selected shape.

image.hintPolyline: Click to place the points of a line. Press Enter, double-click or use the button to finish it.

vqa.hint: Write as many questions as you need about the image.

audio.markStart: Start marked at {{t}}. Press M again for the end.
audio.none: No segment yet. Press M while listening, drag on the waveform, or use “Add here”.
audio.hintSegments: Drag on the waveform to create a region, drag its edges to adjust. Space plays, M marks the start and the end.

dialog.noModel: No model is available for this kind of task.

compare.title: Which model to choose?

compare.best: The best for this kind of task: {{model}} ({{score}}%).
compare.notEnough: Not enough decisions to compare yet (at least {{n}} per model).
compare.how: Score: a proposal validated as it was counts 1, corrected ½, rejected 0. The statistics are kept even if the pre-annotation is deleted.

start.title: Start an evaluation
start.hint: The model is evaluated on a part of a dataset. Every metric of the task is computed.
start.metricsHint: They are all computed and kept. You choose the ones the others will see, and you can change this choice later.

eval.mineHint: You see every metric. Tick the ones other people see.
eval.hiddenBy: {{n}} other metrics were computed but are not shown by {{user}}.

metrics.accuracy: Share of the items correctly classified.
metrics.precision: Of what the model announces, the share that is right.
metrics.recall: Of what had to be found, the share that was found.
metrics.auc: Ability to tell the classes apart, whatever the threshold.
metrics.exact_match: Share of answers identical to the reference, word for word.
metrics.mae: Mean absolute error, in the unit of the value.
metrics.rmse: Root of the mean squared error: punishes big errors.
metrics.r2: Share of the variation explained by the model (1 = perfect).
metrics.mape: Mean error as a percentage of the real value.
metrics.map50: Mean precision of the boxes, with an overlap of at least 50%.
metrics.map50_95: Mean precision with overlap thresholds from 50 to 95%: more demanding.
metrics.chamfer: Mean gap between the predicted line and the real one.
metrics.miou: Mean overlap between predicted and real regions.
metrics.dice: Overlap of regions, like IoU but more lenient.
metrics.pixel_accuracy: Share of the pixels correctly labelled.
metrics.boundary_f1: Quality of the outlines of the regions.
metrics.pck: Share of the keypoints placed close enough to the right spot.
metrics.oks_ap: Mean precision according to the similarity of the keypoints.
metrics.mpjpe: Mean distance between predicted and real points, in pixels.
metrics.bleu: Overlap of words with the reference descriptions.
metrics.rouge_l: Longest run of words shared with the reference.
metrics.cider: Agreement with several references, weighing rare words.
metrics.meteor: Like BLEU, but accounts for synonyms and stems.
metrics.vqa_accuracy: Share of answers judged correct by the reference annotators.
metrics.iou_temporal: Overlap between predicted and real stretches in time.
metrics.boundary_error: Mean gap between predicted and real bounds.
metrics.wer: Word error rate: words replaced, missed and added.
metrics.ser: Share of sentences with at least one error.
metrics.mota: Tracking accuracy: misses, false detections and identity switches.
metrics.idf1: Quality of the identity kept for each tracked object.
metrics.hota: Balance between detecting and associating objects.
metrics.id_switches: Number of times an object changes identity.

files.noneInVersion: This version holds no file: it is only a link to code.

members.title: Access

upload.codeHint: Only a link: nothing is downloaded. It is pinned to its exact commit afterwards.

upload.interrupted_one: An upload of {{count}} file was interrupted.
upload.interrupted_other: An upload of {{count}} files was interrupted.
upload.chooseAgain: Choose the same files again to go on from where it stopped.
upload.partFailed: Part {{number}} of {{path}} did not reach the storage. Try again: what arrived is kept.
upload.wrongFile: {{path}} is not the file that was announced.

collections.title: Collections
collections.subtitle: Selections of datasets and models, with the reasons for gathering them.
collections.newHint: Gather datasets and models around a subject, and say why they are there.
collections.empty: This collection is empty. Add datasets and models to it.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.description: A token lets a program (a script, a notebook, the SDK) act as you, with your rights on the data. It is shown once, when it is made: keep it like a password.
tokens.newHint: Give it a name that says what it is for, and what it may do.

scopeHint.read: Read what you can read. Nothing can be changed.
scopeHint.write: Read, and change what you can change.

tokens.rights: A token never has more rights than you: if you lose access to something, so does it. It is never an administrator, and it cannot make tokens or change your profile.

created.title: Your token
created.warning: Copy it now: it is shown only once, and cannot be read again. If you lose it, revoke it and make another.
